C2.title: Vaqt va davomiylik nozikliklari
C2.can: Zamon shakllari orasidagi eng nozik ma'no farqlarini his qilib ishlata olaman
C2.grammar: Zamon nozikliklari — used to / would / Past Perfect Continuous farqlari (aspect nuance)
C2.explain:
Qoida: used to — o'tmishdagi holat yoki odat · would — faqat takrorlangan harakat · Past Perfect Continuous — nuqtagacha cho'zilgan jarayon
Misol: We used to live there, and every summer my father would take us to the lake. — Biz o'sha yerda yashardik, har yozda otam bizni ko'lga olib borardi.
Misol: By then she had been teaching for thirty years. — O'shanda u o'ttiz yildan beri dars berayotgan edi.

lesson.rule:
C2 darajasida zamonlar nozikligi ma'no qatlamlarini aniq farqlashni talab qiladi.
1. 'Used to' o'tmishdagi holat (states) va odatlarga nisbatan ishlatiladi. O'zbek tilidagi '-rdik' qo'shimchasi bilan bir xil bo'lib tuyuladi, ammo statik fe'llar bilan faqat 'used to' keladi.
2. 'Would' esa faqat takrorlanuvchi harakatlarni (actions) bildiradi, o'tmishdagi holatlarga ishlatib bo'lmaydi ('*He would live there' - xato).
3. 'Past Perfect Continuous' ma'lum bir o'tmish nuqtasigacha to'xtovsiz davom etgan jarayonni ko'rsatib, e'tibor uning davomiyligiga qaratiladi.

examples.en: We used to live in that epoch, and every Sunday my grandfather would recount the chronology.
examples.uz: Biz o'sha davrda yashardik va har yakshanba bobomiz voqealar xronologiyasini so'zlab berardi.
examples.note: Live - holat, shuning uchun used to ishlatildi.

examples.en: By the onset of the new century, she had been working on this enduring project for a decade.
examples.uz: Yangi asr boshlanishiga kelib, u bu uzoq saqlanadigan loyiha ustida o'n yildan beri ishlayotgan edi.

examples.en: His persistent cough was intermittent, marked by sporadic cessation and sudden resumption.
examples.uz: Uning qaytalanuvchi yo'talishi vaqti-vaqti bilan uzilib, to'xtash va to'satdan qayta boshlanishlar bilan ajralib turardi.

examples.en: The fleeting joy was transient, unlike the lasting impact of that momentous era.
examples.uz: O'sha muhim davrning barqaror ta'siridan farqli o'laroq, ko'z ochib yumguncha o'tadigan quvonch o'tkinchi edi.

practice.q: When I was a child, I _____ own a bicycle, and we _____ ride it every afternoon.
By the time the cessation occurred, the machinery _____ continuously for over a decade.
The intermittent and _____ nature of the signal made it difficult to establish chronology.

C2.title: Murakkab ot birikmalari
C2.can: Uzun va zich ot birikmalarini tushunaman va o'zim tuza olaman
C2.grammar: Ot oldidan kelgan aniqlovchilar zanjiri — premodification (complex noun phrases)
C2.explain:
Qoida: ingliz tilida aniqlovchilar OT OLDIDAN zanjir bo'lib keladi; o'zbekchada teskari tartibda o'qiladi
Misol: a long-term risk assessment framework — uzoq muddatli xavfni baholash tizimi
Misol: state-funded higher education institutions — davlat tomonidan moliyalashtiriladigan oliy ta'lim muassasalari

lesson.rule:
C2 darajasida murakkab ot birikmalarini tuzishda ot oldidan keluvchi aniqlovchilar zanjiridan (premodification) foydalanamiz.
Formula: [Modifier/Descriptor/Qualifier] + [Head Noun] (asosiy ot oxirida keladi).
O'zbek tilidan asosiy farqi: o'zbekchada aniqlovchilar chapdan o'ngga (teskari tartibda) tarjima qilinsa, ingliz tilida eng asosiy ot oxirida turadi va uning oldidan bir nechta sifat, ot yoki fe'l shakllari zanjir bo'lib keladi.
O'quvchilar ko'pincha bu zanjirni noto'g'ri tarjima qiladi yoki ortiqcha bog'lovchi qo'shib yuboradi. Masalan, 'state-funded higher education institutions' deganda asosiy ot 'institutions', qolganlari esa uning qandayligini ko'rsatuvchi murakkab aniqlovchilar zanjiridir.

examples.en: A long-term risk assessment framework is essential here.
examples.uz: Bu yerda uzoq muddatli xavfni baholash tizimi muhim.

examples.en: We need state-funded higher education institutions.
examples.uz: Bizga davlat tomonidan moliyalashtiriladigan oliy ta'lim muassasalari kerak.

examples.en: This taxonomy category defines a specific constituent component.
examples.uz: Bu tasnif toifasi aniq bir tashkil etuvchi qismni belgilaydi.

examples.en: A comprehensive spectrum analysis reveals a hidden pattern.
examples.uz: Keng doiradagi tahlil yashirin naqshni ochib beradi.
examples.note: O'zbek tiliga teskari tartibda tarjima qilinadi.

practice.q: Choose the correct complex noun phrase structure for 'davlat moliyalashtiradigan oliy ta'lim muassasalari':
Identify the head noun (asosiy ot) in the phrase: 'a long-term risk assessment framework'.
Which unit word means 'tashkil etuvchi bo'lak' in English?

C2.title: Aytilmagan ma'no
C2.can: Ochiq aytilmagan ma'noni tushunaman va o'zim ham ishora bilan gapira olaman
C2.grammar: Nutq pragmatikasi — bilvosita ifoda va yashirin ma'no (implicature and indirectness)
C2.explain:
Qoida: ingliz tilida rad javob va tanqid ko'pincha BILVOSITA aytiladi — so'zma-so'z ma'no yetarli emas
Misol: That's an interesting approach. — (ko'pincha) Bunga qo'shilmayman.
Misol: I'm afraid we may need to revisit this. — Buni qayta ko'rib chiqishimizga to'g'ri keladi (ya'ni: bu yaramaydi).

lesson.rule:
Ingliz tilida, ayniqsa C2 darajasida, muhim fikrlar ko'pincha so'zma-so'z emas, balki bilvosita (indirectness) yetkaziladi.

Formulalar:
1. Yumshatilgan tanqid: "That's an interesting approach" = "Bu xato / Menga yoqmadi".
2. Euphemism va vagueness: Nozik mavzularda to'g'ridan-to'g'ri (forthright) emas, balki evaziv va tactful so'zlar orqali subtext yaratiladi.

O'zbek tilidan farqi: O'zbekchada ham shama va ishoralar bor, lekin ingliz tilida politeness va decorum qoidalari tufayli tanqidni to'g'ridan-to'g'ri aytish qo'pol hisoblanadi. Shuning uchun mitigator'lar orqali ma'no soften qilinadi. So'zma-so'z tarjima qilsangiz, haqiqiy ma'noni (implicature) tushunmaysiz.

examples.en: That is certainly a brave suggestion, given our current budget.
examples.uz: Hozirgi byudjetimizni hisobga olsak, bu juda 'jasoratli' taklif.
examples.note: Brave bu yerda ahmoqona yoki o'ylamay qilingan degan yashirin ma'noni bildiradi.

examples.en: I am not entirely sure your proposal fully addresses the core issue.
examples.uz: Taklifingiz asosiy muammoni to'liq hal qiladi deb to'liq amin emasman.
examples.note: Xushmuomalalik pardasi ostida taklif rad etilmoqda.

examples.en: We might want to revisit this strategy at a later, more suitable date.
examples.uz: Bu strategiyani keyinroq, mosroq sanada qayta ko'rib chiqsak bo'lar edi.
examples.note: Strategiya yaroqsiz degan ma'noni yumshatib yetkazish.

examples.en: Her tone carried a distinct innuendo regarding his qualifications.
examples.uz: Uning ohangida uning malakasiga nisbatan aniq yopiq kesatiq bor edi.
examples.note: Innuendo ochiq aytilmagan, lekin tushunarli shama.

practice.q: Choose the most indirect and tactful way to reject a bad idea in a professional setting.
options: That is an interesting approach, though we might need to explore other angles.
You don't know what you are talking about.

practice.q: Which linguistic term describes the hidden meaning behind the literal words?
What does the word 'euphemism' mean in pragmatics?
options: A mild or indirect word substituted for one considered to be too harsh
An unclear sentence with a grammar mistake

C2.title: Ishontirish san'ati
C2.can: Fikrimni ta'sirchan va ishonarli qilib himoya qila olaman
C2.grammar: Notiqlik vositalari — takror, qarshilantirish, ritorik savol (rhetorical devices)
C2.explain:
Qoida: ta'sirchanlik uchun takror, uch a'zoli qator va qarshilantirish ishlatiladi
Misol: We asked for time; we asked for support; we asked for honesty. — Biz vaqt so'radik, ko'mak so'radik, halollik so'radik.
Misol: It is not a cost — it is an investment. — Bu xarajat emas, bu sarmoya.

lesson.rule:
C2 darajasida ishontirish san'ati (persuasion) tinglovchiga kuchli ta'sir qilish uchun maxsus notiqlik vositalarini talab qiladi.

1. Takror va parallelizm (repetition & parallelism): Bir xil so'z yoki gap tuzilishini ketma-ket ishlatish orqali xabarni miyaga muhrlaymiz. O'zbek tilida bu urg'uni ohang va qo'shimchalar bilan bersak, ingliz tilida aynan so'zlar va tuzilish takrorlanadi (masalan: We asked for time; we asked for support).

2. Qarshilantirish (antithesis): Ikki qarama-qarshi tushunchani bir gapda yonma-yon qo'yib, farqni yaqqol ko'rsatamiz (It is not a cost — it is an investment).

3. Ritorik savol (rhetorical question): Javob talab qilinmaydigan, faqat o'ylantirish uchun beriladigan savol.

examples.en: We must fight for justice, we must fight for truth, we must fight for our future.
examples.uz: Biz adolat uchun kurashishimiz kerak, haqiqat uchun kurashishimiz kerak, kelajagimiz uchun kurashishimiz kerak.
examples.note: Parallelizm va takror orqali nutqqa kuchli urg'u berildi.

examples.en: It is not a defeat — it is a valuable lesson.
examples.uz: Bu mag'lubiyat emas — bu qimmatli saboq.
examples.note: Antithesis orqali salbiy holat ijobiy ma'noga o'zgartirildi.

examples.en: How can we remain silent in the face of such obvious injustice?
examples.uz: Bunchalik aniq adolatsizlik qarshisida qanday qilib jim tura olamiz?
examples.note: Ritorik savol tinglovchini o'ylashga majbur qiladi.

examples.en: His speech was characterized by rare eloquence and profound authenticity.
examples.uz: Uning nutqi nodir so'zga chechanlik va chuqur haqiqiylik bilan ajralib turardi.
examples.note: Unit so'zlari orqali notiqlik mahorati tasvirlandi.

practice.q: Choose the sentence that correctly uses parallelism and repetition for rhetorical effect.
options: We need power, and then we want to win, and money is also good.
We demand action, we demand justice, we demand change.
We demanded action, justice was what we wanted, and changing things.

practice.q: Identify the correct example of antithesis (qarshilantirish).
options: It is not a burden — it is a privilege.
It is a heavy burden and a big privilege.
It is not a burden, and also it is not a privilege.

practice.q: Choose the best translation for 'so'zga chechanlik' (unit so'zi).

C2.title: Rasmiy hujjat janrlari
C2.can: Hisobot va taklifnomani janr talabiga mos yoza olaman
C2.grammar: Rasmiy yozma janrlar tuzilmasi — hisobot va taklifnoma (formal written genres)
C2.explain:
Qoida: hisobot — o'tgan ish haqida (nima bo'ldi) · taklifnoma — kelajakdagi ish haqida (nima qilinsin)
Misol: This report outlines the findings of the audit. — Ushbu hisobot audit natijalarini bayon qiladi.
Misol: We propose that the pilot be extended by six months. — Sinov bosqichini olti oyga uzaytirishni taklif qilamiz.

lesson.rule:
Rasmiy hujjatlarda (hisobot va taklifnoma) o'zbek tilidan farqli ravishda shaxsiy emas, balki obyektiv va aniq til ishlatiladi.
Hisobot o'tgan ishlar haqida bo'lib, o'tgan zamon yoki holat fe'llarini talab qiladi (masalan, 'The report outlines...').
Taklifnoma va loyiha takliflari (proposal) esa kelajakdagi harakatlar uchun maxsus 'subjunctive' (shart/istak) shakllarni talab qiladi (masalan, 'We propose that the plan be approved').
O'quvchilar ko'pincha takliflarda 'is' yoki 'will' ishlatib xato qilishadi, lekin rasmiy tilda 'be' shakli ishlatilishi shart.

examples.en: This report outlines the findings of the audit.
examples.uz: Ushbu hisobot audit natijalarini bayon qiladi.
examples.note: Hisobotda hozirgi zamon fe'li faktni ko'rsatish uchun ishlatiladi.

examples.en: We propose that the pilot be extended by six months.
examples.uz: Sinov bosqichini olti oyga uzaytirishni taklif qilamiz.
examples.note: Taklifdan keyin 'be extended' kabi subjunctive shakl qo'llaniladi.

examples.en: The feasibility study confirms the scope of the project.
examples.uz: Amalga oshirish imkoniyati tadqiqi loyiha qamrovini tasdiqlaydi.

examples.en: Please review the attached draft before submission.
examples.uz: Iltimos, topshirishdan oldin ilova qilingan qoralamani ko'rib chiqing.

practice.q: We recommend that the new template ___ implemented immediately.
The committee reviewed the minutes and suggested several ___ to the policy.
Which formal document is used to officially propose a new project plan?

C2.title: Ilmiy tanqid tili
C2.can: Tadqiqot yoki fikrni ilmiy me'yorlar asosida baholay olaman
C2.grammar: Baholovchi til — kuchli va zaif tomonni ilmiy uslubda ko'rsatish (academic evaluation)
C2.explain:
Qoida: tanqid shaxsga emas, ISHGA qaratiladi va yumshatuvchi til bilan beriladi
Misol: The study is methodologically sound, though the sample is limited. — Tadqiqot uslubiy jihatdan puxta, biroq tanlanma cheklangan.
Misol: These findings should be treated with caution. — Bu natijalarga ehtiyotkorlik bilan yondashish kerak.

lesson.rule:
Ilmiy tanqid tilida (academic evaluation) fikrlar shaxsga emas, tadqiqot natijalari va uslubiga qaratiladi.

Formulasi: [Ijobiy baho] + [however / although / though] + [yumshatilgan kamchilik / limitation].

O'zbek tilidan farqi: bizda tanqid to'g'ridan-to'g'ri aytilishi mumkin, biroq ingliz akademik stilida keskinlikni pasaytirish uchun 'should be treated with caution' yoki 'might benefit from' kabi yumshatuvchi (hedging) iboralar majburiy ishlatiladi.

examples.en: The study is methodologically sound, though the sample is limited.
examples.uz: Tadqiqot uslubiy jihatdan puxta, biroq tanlanma cheklangan.

examples.en: These findings should be treated with caution due to methodological constraints.
examples.uz: Bu natijalarga uslubiy cheklovlar tufayli ehtiyotkorlik bilan yondashish kerak.
examples.note: Keskin rad etish o'rniga caution ishlatilgan

examples.en: Despite its strengths, the paper lacks sufficient rigour in data analysis.
examples.uz: Kuchli tomonlariga qaramay, maqolada tahlil uchun yetarli ilmiy qat'iylik yo'q.

examples.en: The prevailing consensus is frequently contested by dissenting scholars.
examples.uz: Hozirda hukmron konsensus qarshi fikrdagi olimlar tomonidan tez-tez bahsli qilinadi.

practice.q: Choose the most appropriate academic evaluation structure:
options: The author is wrong because his work has many shortcoming.
The study is methodologically sound, though the sample is limited.
Your research is very bad and has no validity.

practice.q: Select the correct hedging phrase for scientific critique:
options: These findings should be treated with caution.
These results are definitely completely false.
The researcher must be wrong about this.

practice.q: What is the meaning of 'limitation' in academic context?

C2.title: Muzokara va diplomatiya
C2.can: Manfaatlar to'qnashganda ham muomalani buzmasdan muzokara qila olaman
C2.grammar: Muzokara tili — shartli va yumshatuvchi qurilmalar bilan taklif va rad (negotiation language)
C2.explain:
Qoida: qat'iy rad o'rniga shartli qurilma va muqobil taklif beriladi
Misol: We could consider that, provided the timeline is extended. — Muddat uzaytirilsa, buni ko'rib chiqishimiz mumkin.
Misol: That may be difficult for us; would an alternative work? — Bu biz uchun qiyinroq; muqobil variant to'g'ri kelarmidi?

lesson.rule:
Diplomatik muzokaralarda qat'iy rad etish munosabatlarni buzadi. Shu sababli 'may', 'might', 'would' kabi modellar va 'provided that', 'on condition that' kabi shartli bog'lovchilar ishlatiladi.

Formulalar:
1. Yumshatilgan rad: That may be difficult; would [muqobil] work?
2. Shartli qabul: We could [harakat], provided [shart].

O'zbek tilidan farqi: bizda ko'pincha 'mumkin emas' deb keskin aytiladi, ingliz diplomatiyasida esa noaniqlik va shart qo'yish orqali xushmuomalalik saqlanadi.

examples.en: We could consider that, provided the timeline is extended.
examples.uz: Muddat uzaytirilsa, buni ko'rib chiqishimiz mumkin.

examples.en: That may be difficult for us; would an alternative work?
examples.uz: Bu biz uchun qiyin bo'lishi mumkin; muqobil variant to'g'ri kelarmidi?

examples.en: We are willing to accommodate your request if you reciprocate.
examples.uz: Agar javoban shunday qilsangiz, talabingizni hisobga olishga tayyormiz.

examples.en: This deadlock might end if our counterpart breaks the stalemate.
examples.uz: Agar qarshi tomonimiz boshi berk holatni buzsa, bu muzokara to'xtashi tugashi mumkin.

practice.q: Choose the most diplomatic way to reject a strict demand:
options: That may be challenging; would a compromise work?
You must change your conditions right now.

practice.q: Complete the conditional negotiation sentence: 'We will sign the treaty, ... mutual sovereignty is respected.'
Which word means a state where no progress can be made in negotiations?

C2.title: Hazil, kinoya va madaniyat
C2.can: Ingliz tilidagi hazil va kinoyani tushunaman va o'rinli ishlata olaman
C2.grammar: Hazil va kinoya vositalari — satira, so'z o'yini, ohangdagi qarama-qarshilik (humour and irony)
C2.explain:
Qoida: kinoyada aytilgan so'z bilan nazarda tutilgan ma'no QARAMA-QARSHI bo'ladi; ohang hal qiluvchi
Misol: Well, that went brilliantly. — Ha, judayam zo'r ketdi (aslida: yomon bo'ldi).
Misol: He's not exactly a morning person. — U ertalabki odam emasroq (ya'ni: ertalab juda qiyin turadi).

lesson.rule:
C2 darajasida hazil va kinoyani tushunish va ishlatish madaniy kontekstni talab qiladi.
Kinoyada (irony) aytilgan so'zning asl ma'nosi butunlay teskari bo'ladi: ohang (tone) va vaziyat hal qiluvchi rol o'ynaydi. Satira jamiyatdagi illatlarni tanqid qilish uchun ishlatiladi.
O'zbek tilida ham o'xshash kinoya bor, ammo ingliz tilida deadpan (jiddiy qiyofada, mimikasiz) aytish yoki quip (qisqa hozirjavob hazil) qilish madaniy jihatdan o'ziga xosdir.
Formula:
Ironik gap = So'zma-so'z ma'no + Teskari ohang / Vaziyat kontrast.
Diqqat qiling: o'quvchilar ko'pincha deadpan uslubini tushunmay, uni chinakam jiddiy deb o'ylab xato qilishadi.

examples.en: Well, that went brilliantly.
examples.uz: Ha, judayam zo'r ketdi.
examples.note: Aslida hamma narsa barbod bo'lgan vaziyatda aytiladi.

examples.en: He delivered the quip with a totally deadpan expression.
examples.uz: U hozirjavob hazilni butunlay jiddiy qiyofada aytdi.
examples.note: Deadpan - yuzda hech qanday kulgi belgisi yo'qligini bildiradi.

examples.en: His latest novel is a brilliant satire on modern politics.
examples.uz: Uning so'nggi romani zamonaviy siyosatga ajoyib satiradir.

examples.en: Making puns in a serious meeting is quite absurd.
examples.uz: Jiddiy yig'ilishda so'z o'yinlarini qilish juda bema'ni.
examples.note: Pun - bir xil eshitiladigan, lekin ma'nosi har xil so'zlar o'yini.

practice.q: Choose the correct ironical response when it starts pouring rain during a picnic: 'Oh, ... weather we're having!'
Identify the sentence that uses a deadpan delivery style:
options: He laughed loudly while making a joke.
She told a hilarious story with a straight, unsmiling face.
They were smiling and dancing during the banter.

practice.q: What does a 'pun' rely on for its humorous effect?
options: Words with similar sounds but different meanings

C2.title: Badiiy uslub
C2.can: Badiiy matnni tahlil qila olaman va o'zim ta'sirchan bayon yoza olaman
C2.grammar: Badiiy bayon vositalari — tasvir, ramz va hikoya qurilishi (literary style)
C2.explain:
Qoida: badiiy matnda ma'no ko'pincha TASVIR orqali beriladi, to'g'ridan-to'g'ri emas
Misol: The city held its breath. — Shahar nafasini ichiga yutdi (ya'ni: hamma kutib qoldi).
Misol: Years later, that silence still followed him. — Yillar o'tib ham o'sha sukunat uni ta'qib qilardi.

lesson.rule:
Badiiy uslubda (literary style) ma'no to'g'ridan-to'g'ri emas, balki jonlantirish, ramz va tasvir (imagery) orqali ochib beriladi.

Formulasi: Metafora + Sensory details (sezgi detallari) + Subektiv hikoya qurilishi.

O'zbek tilidan farqi: ingliz tilida badiiy matn quruq bayondan qochib, o'quvchida bevosita his uyg'otish uchun 'evoke' fe'li va aniq detallarni ishlatadi. O'quvchilar ko'pincha ilmiy tildagidek 'the situation was bad' deyishadi, lekin adabiyotda 'the shadows stretched wearily' deyilishi kerak.

examples.en: The city held its breath as the protagonist faced the climax.
examples.uz: Bosh qahramon eng yuqori nuqtaga duch kelganda shahar nafasini ichiga yutdi.

examples.en: Years later, that haunting motif still followed him through the prose.
examples.uz: Yillar o'tib ham o'sha ta'qib qiluvchi motiv uni nasr bo'ylab ta'qib qilardi.

examples.en: The omniscient narrator dropped subtle foreshadowing in the prologue.
examples.uz: Hamma narsani biluvchi hikoyachi kirish qismida nozik ishoralar qoldirdi.

examples.en: This allegory manages to evoke deep suspense before the denouement.
examples.uz: Bu majoziy asar yechimdan oldin chuqur taranglik hissini uyg'otishga erishadi.

practice.q: Choose the correct literary framing for an omniscient narrator.
options: The narrator knew secrets the protagonist had not yet discovered.
The narrator knows secrets the protagonist have not yet discovered.
The narrator knowing secrets the protagonist not discovered.

practice.q: Select the correct sentence using foreshadowing.
options: This scene foreshadowing the tragedy that will happen later.
This scene foreshadows the tragedy that will happen later.
This scene is foreshadow the tragedy that will happen later.

practice.q: What is the English equivalent of 'bosh qahramon' in literary terms?

C2.title: Huquqiy va shartnoma tili
C2.can: Shartnoma va huquqiy matnning ma'nosini aniq tushuna olaman
C2.grammar: Huquqiy uslub — majburiyat va istisno ifodalari (legal and contractual English)
C2.explain:
Qoida: huquqiy matnda shall — majburiyat, may — huquq, unless — istisno
Misol: The supplier shall deliver the goods within 30 days. — Yetkazib beruvchi mollarni 30 kun ichida topshirishi shart.
Misol: The agreement may be terminated unless both parties agree otherwise. — Tomonlar boshqacha kelishmasa, shartnoma bekor qilinishi mumkin.

lesson.rule:
Huquqiy matnlarda aniqlik va qat'iylik muhim.
1. 'Shall' so'zi oddiy kelasi zamon emas, balki qat'iy MAJBURIYATni bildiradi (o'zbek tilidagi '-shi shart').
2. 'May' esa huquq yoki ruxsatni bildiradi ('-shi mumkin').
3. 'Unless' — istisno bildiradi ('agar ... bo'lmasa').
O'zbek tilida biz ko'pincha shunchaki fe'l qo'shimchalarini ishlatsak, ingliz huquqiy tilida bu modallar aniq huquqiy oqibatni keltirib chiqaradi va ularni adashtirib bo'lmaydi.

examples.en: The supplier shall deliver the goods within 30 days.
examples.uz: Yetkazib beruvchi mollarni 30 kun ichida topshirishi shart.
examples.note: 'shall' bu yerda qat'iy qonuniy majburiyatni anglatadi.

examples.en: The agreement may be terminated unless both parties agree otherwise.
examples.uz: Tomonlar boshqacha kelishmasa, shartnoma bekor qilinishi mumkin.

examples.en: The defendant shall not be held liable for indirect damages.
examples.uz: Javobgar bilvosita zararlar uchun javobgar deb topilmasligi shart.

examples.en: Either party may seek an injunction in case of a breach.
examples.uz: Har qanday tomon shartnoma buzilgan taqdirda sud taqiqini talab qilishi mumkin.

practice.q: Choose the correct legal modal: The party ___ pay compensation if the contract is breached.
Select the proper restriction: The agreement is void ___ signed by an authorized representative.
Which legal term means 'shartnomani buzish'?

C2.title: Ko'p bo'lakli fe'llar
C2.can: Uch bo'lakli frazal fe'llarni tabiiy va o'rinli ishlata olaman
C2.grammar: Uch bo'lakli frazal fe'llar — put up with, get away with (multi-word verbs)
C2.explain:
Qoida: uch bo'lakli frazal fe'l butunligicha bitta ma'noni beradi va bo'linmaydi
Misol: I can't put up with the noise any longer. — Bu shovqinga endi chiday olmayman.
Misol: They came up with a better solution. — Ular yaxshiroq yechim topishdi.

lesson.rule:
C2 darajasida uch bo'lakli (fe'l + ravish + predlog) frazal fe'llarni mukammal bilish muhim.
Formula: Fe'l + Ravish + Predlog + Obyekt.
Bu fe'llar aslo bo'linmaydi, ya'ni obyekt doimo oxirida keladi.
O'zbek tilida bu fe'llar ko'pincha bitta fe'l yoki qo'shma fe'l bilan tarjima qilinadi, lekin ingliz tilida ular qat'iy uch qismdan iborat bo'lishi shart. O'quvchilar ko'pincha predlogni tushirib qoldirishadi yoki obyektni o'rtaga qo'yib xato qilishadi.

examples.en: I can't put up with the noise any longer.
examples.uz: Bu shovqinga endi chiday olmayman.

examples.en: They came up with a better solution.
examples.uz: Ular yaxshiroq yechim o'ylab topishdi.

examples.en: We need to cut down on sugar consumption.
examples.uz: Shakar iste'molini kamaytirishimiz kerak.

examples.en: She is looking forward to the conference.
examples.uz: U konferensiyani intiqlik bilan kutmoqda.

practice.q: She managed to get _____ cheating on the exam.
We have run _____ coffee, so we need to buy more.
Which phrase means 'to invent or produce an idea'?

C2.title: Manbalarni umumlashtirish
C2.can: Bir necha murakkab manbani birlashtirib, o'z xulosamni bera olaman
C2.grammar: Umumlashtirish tili — bir necha manbani qiyoslab yagona xulosaga keltirish (synthesis)
C2.explain:
Qoida: umumlashtirish — manbalarni ketma-ket bayon qilish emas, ular ORASIDAGI munosabatni ko'rsatish
Misol: While Karimov emphasises cost, Aliyeva points to long-term risk; both, however, assume stable demand. — Karimov xarajatga urg'u bersa, Aliyeva uzoq muddatli xavfni ko'rsatadi; biroq ikkalasi ham talab barqarorligini shart qilib oladi.
Misol: Taken together, the evidence points in one direction. — Umuman olganda, dalillar bir yo'nalishni ko'rsatadi.

lesson.rule:
C2 darajasida manbalarni umumlashtirish (synthesis) - bu shunchaki ularni ketma-ket qayta aytish emas, balki ular orasidagi bog'liqlik, ziddiyat yoki uyg'unlikni ko'rsatib, yagona xulosa chiqarishdir.
Formula: [Manba A kontrast/mos keladi] + [Manba B] + [Umumiy xulosa iborasi (masalan, Taken together / Ultimately)].
O'zbek tilida biz ko'pincha dalillarni shunchaki sanab o'tamiz, lekin ingliz tilida akademik darajada manbalarni o'zaro taqqoslab, ularning mohiyatini "distil" (eng muhimini ajratib olish) va "synthesise" qilish talab etiladi. Nuanslarni sezish va o'xshashliklarni "juxtapose" qilish orqali kuchli xulosa yasaladi.

examples.en: While Karimov emphasises cost, Aliyeva points to long-term risk; both, however, assume stable demand.
examples.uz: Karimov xarajatga urg'u bersa, Aliyeva uzoq muddatli xavfni ko'rsatadi; biroq ikkalasi ham talab barqarorligini shart qilib oladi.
examples.note: Zaruriy kontrastni ko'rsatish uchun "while" va "however" ishlatildi.

examples.en: Taken together, the diverse findings synthesise into a comprehensive overview.
examples.uz: Umuman olganda, turli xil topilmalar yaxlit umumiy ko'rinishga birlashadi.
examples.note: "Taken together" bir nechta manbani birlashtirishda asqotadi.

examples.en: When we juxtapose these reports, a glaring contradiction is discerned.
examples.uz: Bu hisobotlarni yonma-yon qo'yib qiyoslasak, yaqqol ziddiyat seziladi.
examples.note: "Juxtapose" manbalarni solishtirish uchun juda mos fe'l.

examples.en: The final chapter attempts to distill the exhaustive data into succinct insights.
examples.uz: Oxirgi bob to'liq ma'lumotlarni qisqa va lo'nda tushunchalarga ajratib olishga harakat qiladi.

practice.q: Choose the correct sentence that properly synthesises two contrasting sources.
options: While Source A argues X, Source B claims Y; nevertheless, both agree on Z.
Source A argues X and Source B claims Y and both agree Z.
While Source A arguing X, Source B claimed Y, both agreed Z.

practice.q: Which phrase is best used to introduce a combined conclusion from multiple sources?
What does the academic word 'synthesise' mean in the context of research?
options: To copy data word for word without changing anything
To combine different sources or ideas into a coherent whole
